# Repository instructions

- Keep the quiz as a single, dependency-free `index.html`, with its CSS and JavaScript inline, unless an issue explicitly requests a change.
- Preserve semantic HTML and keyboard accessibility, including keyboard navigation and visible focus.
- Preserve support for `prefers-color-scheme` and `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- When changing behavior, test the affected behavior in the integrated browser and report what you verified. If browser testing is unavailable, state that limitation instead of claiming verification.
